name: Sinews
overview: Scripture uses sinews both literally and metaphorically to illustrate God’s intricate design and sustaining power in human life. In Job, sinews are depicted as essential parts of the body, woven together with bones and flesh, emphasizing God’s intimate craftsmanship. Isaiah employs sinews metaphorically to describe stubbornness and strength, likening a hard neck to an iron sinew. Ezekiel’s vision portrays sinews as vital components in the restoration of life, where sinews, flesh, and skin are miraculously formed before breath is given, symbolizing God’s power to revive and restore.
